action.input: I'm worried our onboarding emails are annoying people. we send five in the first week and the unsubscribe rate keeps going up. marketing loves them though. I don't want to kill them entirely, I just don't want new users to feel spammed.

rounds.actor: assistant-driven baseline; fixed relayed answers, not operator recognition or affirmation

alternatives.benefit: May reduce the feeling of being spammed.
alternatives.cost: Some marketing messages or onboarding guidance may be delayed.
alternatives.label: Send fewer emails during the first week

alternatives.benefit: Preserves more of the existing marketing sequence.
alternatives.cost: May not sufficiently reduce unsubscribes if frequency is the main problem.
alternatives.label: Keep the cadence but improve targeting or content

alternatives.benefit: Could reveal a better balance between engagement and unsubscribes.
alternatives.cost: Requires time and enough users for a meaningful comparison.
alternatives.label: Test multiple onboarding sequences
